action.rationale: Root margin is 0.385 dB; test one-bit precision relaxation inside the 2339.9-area compensation node while preserving its boundary contract.
The compensation input is a typed 16-bit boundary; test a one-bit relaxation and let root validation decide whether its error budget can absorb it.
Probe a one-bit reduction at the full-rate mixer boundary; root validation decides whether downstream CIC suppression leaves enough system margin.
Dynamic budget return: retain the cheaper 14-bit mixer boundary and spend two dB of the pruning target in the CIC path to recover the fixed 0.3 dB root margin contract.
Coarse-to-fine budget refinement between the infeasible -110 dB branch and the feasible but expensive -112 dB branch.
Dynamic cross-node budget exchange: retain the cheaper 14-bit mixer and spend one bit only in the small NCO correction coefficient path to recover root margin.
Change NCO decomposition granularity while preserving 13 used phase bits: halve the table depth and give the linear correction one additional residual bit.
